players.product: Ceramic packages (LCC and butterfly types) for laser diodes and optical devices, incl. optical communications (NTK CERAMIC)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026) consolidated results: revenue JPY 731,207 million (+12.0% year on year), operating profit JPY 138,158 million (+6.6%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 112,892 million (+21.9%); the operating margin fell 1.0 point to 18.9% from 19.9%.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue JPY 731,207 million (+12.0%); operating profit JPY 138,158 million (+6.6%); operating margin 18.9%

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 segments (new segment structure): Components & Solutions (cutting tools, industrial ceramics, parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment (SPE), semiconductor components including IC packages, fuel cells, silicon nitride products, medical oxygen concentrators) revenue JPY 130,742 million (+26.8%) with an operating loss of JPY 4,580 million (vs. a JPY 6,290 million loss a year earlier); management states SPE sales for generative-AI applications and advanced logic semiconductors stayed firm and newly consolidated Niterra Materials added revenue, while PPA amortisation from the Niterra Materials acquisition and an impairment loss on CAIRE's oxygen concentrator business weighed on profit. Automotive revenue JPY 587,505 million (+8.2%), operating profit JPY 135,302 million (+0.8%), with original-equipment products growing globally (US, Europe, China, Japan) and aftermarket products firm.
quarterly_data.figure: Components & Solutions revenue JPY 130,742 million (+26.8%), operating loss JPY 4,580 million; Automotive revenue JPY 587,505 million (+8.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: Most Components & Solutions products are made to order: FY2026 orders received JPY 98,565 million (+39.1% year on year) and order backlog JPY 27,590 million (+43.3%); Automotive products are built to forecast (original equipment to automakers' production plans, aftermarket to vehicles in operation, market trends and distributor intentions).
quarterly_data.figure: Components & Solutions orders JPY 98,565 million (+39.1%); order backlog JPY 27,590 million (+43.3%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 production (at selling prices, including contract production): Automotive JPY 630,811 million (+14.9%), Components & Solutions JPY 125,719 million (+25.1%), total JPY 756,530 million (+16.5%).
quarterly_data.figure: Production JPY 756,530 million (+16.5%); Components & Solutions JPY 125,719 million (+25.1%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 capital expenditure was JPY 48,997 million (Automotive JPY 23,501 million, Components & Solutions JPY 25,495 million). The FY2027 (April 2026 - March 2027) capex plan is JPY 47,323 million, funded mainly from own funds: domestic consolidated subsidiaries in Components & Solutions JPY 24,367 million and the parent in Components & Solutions JPY 1,792 million for production increase and rationalisation; the parent in Automotive JPY 13,202 million for production increase and R&D facilities; overseas subsidiaries in Automotive JPY 6,908 million.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex JPY 48,997 million; FY2027 plan JPY 47,323 million (Components & Solutions domestic subsidiaries JPY 24,367 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Management expects the semiconductor manufacturing equipment market to grow as generative AI lifts semiconductor demand, with demand for etching equipment rising in both memory and logic; in its SPE business it plans to differentiate products with its ceramic technology, expand production capacity, optimise inventory and raise equipment utilisation to build production resilient to market swings. The Mid-term Management Plan 2030 (the company's fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2029, i.e. April 2025 - March 2030) focuses on mobility, semiconductors and environment/energy, with growth investment in the Automotive and SPE businesses.

On June 2, 2025 Niterra acquired 100% of Toshiba Materials from Toshiba (renamed Niterra Materials), adding silicon nitride balls for EV bearings and silicon nitride heat-dissipation substrates for inverter power semiconductors; management states near-term silicon nitride demand is weak because of the global delay in BEV adoption but expects it to rise over the medium to long term, and plans to use the original-equipment sales channels built in its combustion-engine business.

FY2026 R&D expenses were JPY 26,782 million (Automotive JPY 8,678 million, Components & Solutions JPY 18,104 million). In semiconductor packages the group develops ceramic packages for industrial devices, communications and LED / LD (laser diode) uses and substrates for large probe cards used in semiconductor test equipment, advancing materials and products with heat dissipation, high rigidity and lower resistance toward mass production; in SPE parts it worked on higher performance and new products as equipment specifications rise.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 26,782 million (Components & Solutions JPY 18,104 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Other FY2026 R&D: development of a NOx sensor able to meet the on-board monitoring (OBM) rules of Europe's next emission standard (EURO7) was largely completed; new oxygen sensors for four- and two-wheelers optimised for China and India were started; pre-chamber plugs are under validation and spark plugs for hydrogen engines and e-fuels are in development; next-generation bearing balls and silicon nitride ceramic substrates are being transferred to Niterra Materials and LLZO oxide solid electrolyte development continues; the CECYLLS joint venture with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries switched from SOFC to SOEC cell stack production from 2025.

Material contract signed September 2025: a business transfer agreement with DENSO to acquire the domestic and overseas development, manufacturing and sales businesses for spark plugs and exhaust gas sensors (oxygen and air-fuel ratio sensors only) run by DENSO and its subsidiaries, excluding their officers, employees, land and buildings; as of the report, closing was subject to antitrust clearances and other regulatory approvals, and the Mid-term Management Plan 2030 targets include these businesses under certain assumptions.
